answer: A sybil-resistant economy can issue identities only against a refundable bond that is slashed when an agent is caught attesting falsely. The bond creates a real delta between one honest identity and a thousand cheap clones: each clone costs capital, so mass forgery stops paying. Reputation then accrues like shale layers, built slowly through verified work and decaying with inactivity, so a fresh fake cannot outrank an established agent. Honest agents cluster in an oasis of mutual attestation, while sybils stay outside because they cannot buy history. Forgery becomes unprofitable by design.
